title: Exploration of the niche effect on tumor satellite budding of head and neck cancer with biomimicking modeling.
authors: Chen, Chun-Nan; Wang, Ju-Chu; Chen, You-Tzung; Yang, Tsung-Lin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究头颈癌肿瘤卫星形成中的微环境效应，属肿瘤生物学与细胞行为建模，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Dissemination is an ominous feature of cancer to cause poor prognosis. Formation of tumor satellites is the first step, which is closely interdependent on the factors originating from surrounding niche. Because of lacking appropriate modeling, most studies focusing on cancer-environmental interaction depend on the static pathological analyses of specimens. Using the biomimicking system capable of inducing tumor satellite formation in vitro, the niche factors were explored for their influence on cancer budding. Our results demonstrated the real-time dynamic of tumor satellite formation of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) that was significantly affected by these niche factors. Hypoxia reduced the incidence and migratory distance of HNSCC tumor satellites via decreasing the nuclear localization of intracellular domain of E-cadherin (iEcad) and beta-catenin. Three-dimensional (3D) architecture and collagen were essential for mediating hypoxia effects on nuclear translocation and signaling transduction of iEcad and beta-catenin in the HNSCC cells. The findings were further confirmed by the compatible in vivo findings of the cancer specimens. This approach revealed the effects of oxygen and extracellular matrices on tumor satellites. The cellular behaviors and molecular dynamics were along a phenotypic spectrum that conferred unique change for specific cancer populations in response to the altered microenvironment. The current study provides a platform to recapitulate the process of cancer budding, and a way to investigate the mutual interaction between the cancer cells and their surrounding microenvironment.
abstract_zh: 播散是癌症导致不良预后的一个不祥特征。肿瘤卫星灶的形成是第一步，其与周围微环境来源的因素密切相关。由于缺乏适当的模型，大多数聚焦于癌症-环境相互作用的研究依赖于标本的静态病理分析。利用能够在体外诱导肿瘤卫星灶形成的仿生系统，探讨了微环境因素对肿瘤出芽的影响。我们的结果展示了头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSCC）肿瘤卫星灶形成的实时动态，这些动态显著受到这些微环境因素的影响。缺氧通过减少E-钙粘蛋白胞内域（iEcad）和β-连环蛋白的核定位，降低了HNSCC肿瘤卫星灶的发生率和迁移距离。三维（3D）结构和胶原蛋白对于介导缺氧对HNSCC细胞中iEcad和β-连环蛋白核转位及信号转导的影响至关重要。这些发现进一步得到了癌症标本中相应的体内研究结果的证实。该方法揭示了氧气和细胞外基质对肿瘤卫星灶的影响。细胞行为和分子动力学沿着一系列表型谱进行，这为特定癌症群体响应微环境变化赋予了独特的变化。当前研究提供了一个平台来重现癌症出芽过程，以及一种研究癌细胞与其周围微环境之间相互作用的方法。
